en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a masonry lookout tower attached to a rectangular building on a low hill. The tower has arched windows, a balcony near the top, and a decorative crenellated crown with a small spire. Some foliage appears in the foreground and to the right. Handwritten-style captions at the bottom read a city name on the left and the name of the lookout tower on the right.
